onboarding.title: Employer profile
onboarding.step_type_subtitle: This determines how you appear in your listings. You can change it later in settings.
onboarding.type_company_desc: LLCs, JSCs and other legal entities. Company page, logo, team members.
onboarding.type_ie_desc: Registered individual entrepreneurs. Company page and verification via TIN.
onboarding.type_person_desc: Private individuals looking for help at home, for the family or for one-off jobs.
onboarding.step_company_subtitle: For the public page candidates see. Fields marked with an asterisk are required.
onboarding.step_person_subtitle: Candidates will see this information in your listings.
onboarding.done_toast: Welcome! You can now post a vacancy.
onboarding.logo_later: You can also upload a logo later in settings.
onboarding.logo_failed: The company was created, but the logo failed to upload. You can upload it in settings.
onboarding.type_government_desc: Ministries, khokimiyats, state enterprises, schools, hospitals and other government institutions. Once verified, your vacancies will appear in a separate section with a "Government organization" badge.
onboarding.type_self_employed_desc: No company name or tax ID needed — post under your own name.
onboarding.type_other_desc: Not in the list? Describe it briefly (e.g. foundation, cooperative).

form.logo_hint: JPG, PNG, WEBP or SVG, up to 3 MB
form.about_placeholder: What you do, your team, working conditions...
form.display_name_hint: This name is shown as the employer in your listings
form.person_about_placeholder: What kind of work you're hiring for...

dashboard.subtitle: Skip the endless CVs. Find the right hire.
dashboard.empty_title: You haven't created a vacancy yet
dashboard.empty_desc: Post your first vacancy — matching candidates will be shortlisted automatically.
dashboard.post_vacancy_hint: 3 minutes: profession → conditions → publish. We show matching candidates right away

company.meta_description: Active vacancies and company information for {name} on «Ish Beruvchi»

settings.title: Company settings
settings.readonly_notice: Only the owner or an administrator can edit company details.
settings.create_company_desc: Create a company to get a company page, logo, team members and verification.

members.title: Team members
members.remove_confirm_desc: {name} will lose access to the company's vacancies and applications.
members.invite_desc: Create an invite link and send it to the member. They sign in to «Ish Beruvchi», open the link and join the team. The link is valid for 7 days.
members.roles_help: Administrator — all settings and members; Recruiter — vacancies and applications; Viewer — view only.
members.admin_only: Only the owner or an administrator can manage members.

verification.title: Verification
verification.desc_company: Verified companies earn more trust from candidates and show a «Verified» badge in search.
verification.desc_person: Verifying your identity makes candidates trust your listings more.
verification.documents_hint: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 15 MB each, max 5
verification.submitted: Request submitted. A moderator will review it within 1–2 business days.
verification.pending_notice: Your request is under review. You'll be notified of the result.
verification.admin_only: Only the company owner or an administrator can submit a verification request.

errors.not_admin: Administrator rights are required for this action
errors.owner_locked: The owner's role can't be changed
errors.already_pending: Your request is already under review
errors.invite_invalid: The invite link is invalid or has expired

join.title: Company invitation
join.desc: You've been invited to join a company team. Once you accept, you'll be able to work with the company's vacancies and applications.
join.invalid_desc: The link has expired, was already used or is incorrect. Ask an administrator for a new one.
join.missing_token: The link has no invite code
